section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the 16-item, 2-factor Family Fat Talk Questionnaire (FFTQ-F) with Family and Self subscales, each comprised of 8 items rated 1 (Never) to 5 (Always). It summarizes prior validation (internal consistencies: Self α = 0.88; Family α = 0.90; subscale correlation r = 0.34) and states that the present analysis focused only on the Family subscale (α = 0.92). No study identifiers (e.g., 'Study 1') or sample/study-level demographic, BMI, or collection-method details are provided.
section_summary.evidence_source: Key sentences: 'The 16-item, 2-factor Family Fat Talk Questionnaire (FFTQ-F; MacDonald et al., 2015) measures ...' and 'The present analysis only focused on the Family subscale, which demonstrated an excellent level of internal consistency (α = 0.92).'
